status: Upstream elekloader core-dt2 1.0 for Digitakt II OS 1.17 is what the site builds with. The entries marked since 1.1 are proposed for Modwerk's Digitakt II base (core-dt2 1.1's source, sdk/machines/digitakt-ii/elekloader/); a module that needs one waits for the base, and the machine's core version stays 1.0 until it ships.

events.name: ev_tick
events.when: the UI compose check, approximately 30 Hz
events.handler: void f(void *ctrl); set ctrl + 0x20 to 1 to request redraw; not an audio-rate clock

events.name: ev_draw
events.when: after the OS composes the 128x64 screen

events.name: ev_key
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_enc
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_frame_params
events.when: once a frame, in the frame interrupt, before the stock modulators add their values
events.handler: void f(int16_t *values, int stride); track t's value j at values[stride * t + j], stride 71; add to it, held in the parameter's range; the kit and the pages are untouched
events.order: lower order first (shipped mods use 10-90); every handler sees the values the earlier ones left

events.name: ev_key_leds
events.when: every UI frame, after the frame clears the key LEDs and before the stock views set theirs (UI task)
events.handler: void f(void *mgr); set an LED with fw_led_set(mgr, logical, 2, value); the first setter of an LED wins, so a handler's LED stays over the stock view's
events.order: lower order first (shipped mods use 10-90); the first handler to set an LED keeps it

tables.name: core_fast
tables.purpose: Copy-table entries used to move linked .fast code into the Digitakt II SRAM tail on the first UI tick.

tables.name: core_projdata
tables.purpose: Pointers to core_projdata_t descriptors {tag[4], size, data, loaded}: each mod's block in the project file's header gap (+0x1c to +0x200), saved with every project save and loaded back. Reader: core's store (project save and load sites). A mod claims projdata:<tag>.

tables.name: core_kitdata
tables.purpose: Pointers to core_kitdata_t descriptors {tag[4], size, data, changed}: each mod's block per kit (128 kits), after each kit record's end mark, saved with the project and SAVE KIT, loaded back and copied with the firmware's kit copies. All mods share 191 bytes a kit record (core_kitdata_room()); a block that does not fit is left out. Reader: core's store. A mod claims kitdata:<tag>.

sites.role: memcpy: follows kit copies in RAM (pattern copy and paste, PASTE KIT, undo)

exports.name: core_additem
exports.purpose: Add a SETTINGS or PERSONALIZE row from the corresponding event handler.

exports.name: core_addvalue
exports.purpose: Add a PERSONALIZE or SETTINGS row that shows a label and, on the right as LED INTENSITY does, values[get()]; from ev_personalize or ev_settings.

exports.name: core_notice
exports.purpose: Show a message in the header, as a page's title (UI task).

exports.name: core_view_top
exports.purpose: The vtable of the view on top of the stack.

exports.name: core_kit_on
exports.purpose: The kit on (the pattern on's), -1 for none.

exports.name: core_kit_index
exports.purpose: A kit in RAM's number, -1 when it is not one of the project's.

exports.name: core_kitdata_room
exports.purpose: Bytes a kit record holds for the mods' blocks (191).

exports.name: core_store_conflicts
exports.purpose: How many times a save or a load met bytes in the mods' areas that are not core's; core left them as they were.

exports.name: fw_*
exports.prototype: mk2/core.h: fw_fillrect, fw_textf, fw_led_set, fw_key_down, fw_toast and the other firmware routines and data
exports.purpose: Firmware locations as exports, by address and without stock bytes, so a mod calls the OS's drawing, keys, LEDs, card and strings without its own copy of each address.
